evidence_extracts.bounded_claim: Reproducing identical outputs can preserve a code error; transparency permits examination but does not itself establish correctness. Consistency tolerances require understanding numerical issues.
evidence_extracts.explicit_limits: Consensus guidance, not an empirical agent comparison or proof that any independent reviewer is reliable.
evidence_extracts.reusable_comparison: Position the guide as extending established computational science practice to agent-produced work; retain domain judgment beyond reruns.

evidence_extracts.reusable_comparison: Availability promises and published papers warrant operational reproduction evidence, not assumed validity.

evidence_extracts.bounded_claim: In a randomized trial, 16 experienced open-source contributors completed 246 real tasks; AI access increased completion time 19%, despite perceived speedup.
evidence_extracts.explicit_limits: Early-2025 tools, mature familiar repositories, software work; authors explicitly reject generalization to most developers or other domains. Benchmarks can both overestimate and underestimate practical utility.
evidence_extracts.reusable_comparison: Use only as evidence that usefulness and productivity need context-specific measurement; not evidence that agents are generally worse scientists.

evidence_extracts.bounded_claim: CODECHECK reports 25 reproductions and separates independent execution from traditional peer review. Step 3 explicitly limits its check to workflow mechanics, excluding whether the right algorithm solves the research problem.
evidence_extracts.explicit_limits: Feasibility demonstrations are not controlled evidence of improved scientific validity; a badge compresses check scope and can confuse readers.
evidence_extracts.reusable_comparison: Direct prior art for human-readable, scoped reproduction evidence. Acknowledge it before discussing agent-specific extensions.

method_candidates.transfer_hypothesis: A separate reproduction packet could make a physics reviewer’s inspection cheaper; effectiveness is untested here.
Map selected manuscript results to compact evidence records rather than asking reviewers to read full agent transcripts.
Keep bibliography correction separate from scientific evidence checking to prevent a real DOI being treated as sufficient support.
A compact record could let scientific reviewers assess what an agent result actually demonstrated without interpreting a badge.

gaps: No controlled evidence here that multiple agents provide statistically independent scientific review; different model names do not establish independence.
No general frontier-model-versus-human comparison follows across physics, ML replication and software productivity settings.
Citation existence and correct bibliography are distinct from semantic support; this audit directly tests only the former and bibliographic correctness.
Bug discovery is valuable local evidence; these sources do not quantify how bug detection changes a complete physical inference.
Stodden full methods remain a retrieval gap; manuscript may cite the abstract-bounded finding with that limitation, or obtain full text before discussing estimators.
aiXiv seeds also identify ReScience, PROV, CWLProv and RO-Crate; not independently source-checked in this bounded eight-source lane. Treat those as leads, not evidence.

contradictions.apparent_conflict: Impressive benchmark performance versus METR 2025 developer slowdown
contradictions.resolution: Different task contexts, success criteria, scaffolds and human interaction; no direct contradiction or universal ranking.
Later observations are selection-biased and explicitly weak evidence for effect size; preserve temporal and design limits.

contradictions.apparent_conflict: A reproduced output versus an incorrect scientific result
contradictions.resolution: NASEM explicitly notes that rerunning erroneous code reproduces an error; independent reasoning and validation remain necessary.
